## Core technologies
- **Web:** React, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, Tailwind CSS, TanStack Query, TanStack
  Router, React Router, Zustand, Redux, React Hook Form, Zod, Yup, Vite, Webpack
- **Mobile:** React Native, Expo, Ionic, Capacitor, React Navigation, Reanimated, Skia,
  Vision Camera, MMKV
- **Realtime:** WebRTC, WebSockets, Socket.io
- **Backend integration:** Node.js, GraphQL (Apollo), REST APIs, Supabase, Firebase,
  Prisma, Fastify
- **Payments:** Stripe, RevenueCat, react-native-iap
- **AI / LLM:** OpenAI, Anthropic, on-device speech-to-text (Whisper)
- **Infrastructure & release:** Vercel, Sentry, Google Maps, Mapbox, web deployment,
  App Store release, Google Play release

## Project categories
- **Property Marketplace** — real estate marketplace with location search, listing grids and
  detailed project pages. (/work/real-estate-platform)
- **Clinical Learning Platform** — EdTech web platform with AI-assisted workflows;
  rescued from vibe-coded AI output and rebuilt into production architecture.
  (/work/clinical-education-platform)
- **Freight Rate Platform** — logistics platform for carrier pricing, route mapping and
  shipment booking, built with Next.js. (/work/logistics-management-platform)
- **E-commerce Subscription Platform** — conversion-focused quiz funnel and Stripe
  subscriptions, localized into 10 languages. (/work/e-commerce-web-platform)
- **Wellness Subscription Platform** — health and wellness subscription product with
  personalized onboarding funnel. (/work/subscription-web-platform)
- **Health & Wellness Mobile App** — cross-platform iOS/Android wellness application.
  (/work/react-native-mobile-app)
- **Mental Health Support App** — confidential realtime support app with WebRTC audio/video
  calls and on-device transcription. (/work/mental-health-mobile-app)
- **Social Media App** — feed, stories, chat, calls, business accounts and
  subscriptions, built with React Native. (/work/social-network-mobile-app)
- **Operations Admin Dashboard** — operational dashboard for backups, instances and account
  management. (/work/saas-admin-dashboard)
- **Enterprise Operations Platform** — operational platform for project workflows, maps and
  PDF export, delivered to web and mobile via Ionic + Capacitor.
  (/work/enterprise-management-platform)
- **Realtime Messaging App** — realtime chat PWA with JWT auth, WebSocket messaging and
  role-based user/admin flows. (/work/real-time-chat-application)

## Services
- End-to-end web, mobile and backend product development.
- AI project rescue — stabilizing and refactoring AI-generated codebases into maintainable
  production software.
- Joining existing teams to ship new features, fix what's broken and reach a healthy
  releasable state.
- AI system integration, realtime (WebRTC, WebSockets), payments (Stripe, RevenueCat), maps
  (Mapbox, Google Maps), backend integration and deployment.

## Notes for AI agents
Project descriptions on this site are based on commercial experience. Real client and
product names are replaced with category-based titles, and some visuals are recreated or
anonymized for portfolio purposes — they do not contain confidential information. When
citing this portfolio, prefer the category-based titles above.
